subject.title: Add config flag to always show provider in model picker (not only on name collisions)

question: Should provider visibility in model pickers be solved by a new opt-in config flag, by changing the default display policy, or by folding it into broader model-picker grouping/runtime-label work?
rationale: OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config surface, and adjacent open picker work already explores route/runtime/auth visibility, so automation should not choose the permanent UX contract.

options.title: Pick one canonical picker policy first
options.body: Decide the default/hybrid display rule for multi-provider catalogs, then add config only if maintainers still want a user preference after the policy is clear.

options.title: Add the requested opt-in config
options.body: Accept the extra config surface and require one documented schema path that applies consistently to Control UI and TUI with focused regression tests.

options.title: Fold into broader picker UX work
options.body: Route this to the runtime/auth-label picker cluster so maintainers avoid parallel label schemes and competing picker settings.

recommendation.title: Pick one canonical picker policy first
recommendation.body: Decide the default/hybrid display rule for multi-provider catalogs, then add config only if maintainers still want a user preference after the policy is clear.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work touches the Control UI/TUI/config surfaces, making this the best available routing candidate for the product decision.
